title: Strong monoidal structure on $g^*$
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ and $g$ be as in [lem-sfb-finite-upper-star-unit]. The *monoidal
structure* on $g^*$ is the oplax monoidal structure mate, under $g^*\dashv g_*$
([def-sfb-finite-upper-lower-star-adjunction]), of the lax structure of
[def-sfb-finite-lower-star-lax-monoidal]. Its structure maps are invertible by
[lem-sfb-finite-upper-star-unit] and [lem-sfb-finite-upper-star-tensor], so $g^*$ is a
strong monoidal functor.

proof.text:
Write $\mathcal C=\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)$ and $\mathcal D=\Sh(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)$. They carry the sheaf tensor monoidal structures by [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor], applied to the closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian category of the item. Put $L=g^*$ and $R=g_*$. By [def-sfb-finite-upper-lower-star-adjunction] fix its natural Hom bijections $\Phi$ and unit $u_F:F\to RL F$. By [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-lax-monoidal] take the given lax unit $e:\mathbf 1_{\mathcal C}\to R\mathbf 1_{\mathcal D}$ and lax tensor maps $m_{V,W}:RV\otimes RW\to R(V\otimes W)$. Apply [lem-sfb-adjunction-oplax-mate] to this adjunction and this lax structure. It equips the actual functor $L$ with the oplax maps
$$
 d_0=\Phi_{\mathbf 1_{\mathcal C},\mathbf 1_{\mathcal D}}^{-1}(e),\qquad
 d_{F,G}=\Phi_{F\otimes G,LF\otimes LG}^{-1}\bigl(m_{LF,LG}\circ(u_F\otimes u_G)\bigr).
$$
Thus the construction satisfies oplax associativity and both unit axioms. These are precisely the mates specified in the item; the tensor mate uses the two adjunction unit components before the lax tensor map.

proof.text: The formula for $d_0$ is exactly the mate of the lax unit appearing in [lem-sfb-finite-upper-star-unit], so that lemma makes $d_0$ invertible. For arbitrary $F,G\in\mathcal C$, the formula for $d_{F,G}$ is the tensor mate appearing in [lem-sfb-finite-upper-star-tensor], so that lemma makes every $d_{F,G}$ invertible. Both lemmas have exactly the present closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficients and arbitrary scheme morphism; neither requires $g$ weakly étale.

source.place: Last sentence: identify and apply the two existing comparison isomorphism lemmas.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-strong-monoidal-of-invertible-oplax] to the oplax structure of step 1 and the isomorphisms of step 2. Define the lax unit to be $d_0^{-1}$ and the lax tensor map on $F,G$ to be $d_{F,G}^{-1}$. The cited construction gives a strong monoidal structure with these maps and with the original oplax maps. This is the monoidal structure prescribed by the item: it is built from the fixed adjunction and fixed pushforward lax structure and introduces no unrelated choice of tensor comparisons.
